summary: Add a program catalog and host selection, move coding agents to mise on Linux and Homebrew on macOS, support writable settings with generation diff backups, and adopt the upstream Paneru Accessibility fix.
migration: Enable Homebrew on macOS consumers that use provider-managed Codex and Claude Code. Linux supplies both through mise. Remove overlapping installation declarations and verify command resolution in a fresh shell. Selected Ghostty, Paneru, WezTerm and Zellij settings reset to the incoming generation on switch after numbered diff backups. Check Accessibility access for the new Paneru executable.
